settings.models.welcomeBody:
DeepSeek Harness 0.2 is still in preview, and many areas need continued improvement and refinement. We welcome feedback and suggestions from all developers and users. The new desktop app now targets a broad range of users, while developer-related advanced features can be enabled in the settings. DeepSeek Harness’s product features and plugin APIs are expected to continue rapid iteration and evolution, and will gradually stabilize over time.

We look forward to exploring the limits of intelligence together with users and developers around the world, building on open-source, reusable, and composable infrastructure. We welcome everyone to bring their ideas to life with DeepSeek Harness and participate in the community to enrich the plugin ecosystem.

stats.column.scope.title: A turn row holds the turn total; click a row to expand or collapse its steps
stats.column.prompt.title: What opened this turn: a human prompt shows its text, automation shows a source badge
stats.column.did.title: Tools this step called and how often; a step without tool calls previews its answer text
stats.column.context.title: usage input tokens + cache read + cache write
stats.column.output.title: usage output tokens of the step
stats.column.cache.title: cache read ÷ (input + cache read + cache write): the share of the prompt served from cache
stats.column.ttft.title: step start to the first output fragment (TTFT)
stats.column.model.title: step start to the settled reply (includes the first-token delay)
stats.column.tps.title: output tokens ÷ generation seconds (TPS, tok/s)
stats.column.tool.title: sum of every tool call up to its result inside the step; calls without a result are excluded
stats.column.time.title: total split: light blue first token, blue generation, orange tool calls, gray everything else. Bar length uses a square-root scale; steps compare only with steps of the same turn, turns with turns
stats.turn.label: Turn {turn}

stats.step.started.title: Step started at {time}
stats.compaction.label: Compaction

stats.context.delta.title: Prompt delta against the previous measured step in the turn; negative means the context shrank (for example after compaction)
stats.event.attempt.detail: Model attempt without a committed message

stats.state.aborted.title: The step closed without a settled reply (usually cancelled or failed)

stats.empty: No measurable step in the current window.
stats.contextMode.label: Context basis
stats.contextMode.latest.title: Turn rows show the last measured step's prompt size (final context); the total row stays cumulative
stats.contextMode.cumulative.title: Turn rows show the sum of prompt sizes across the turn's steps (cumulative processing); the total row stays cumulative
stats.totals.full.title: Totals for the complete session; total time is model time + tool time (no inter-turn gaps)
stats.totals.window.title: Totals for the turns loaded in this window; the context cell is cumulative across steps
